simple.summary: תְּבַּלֻּל (tᵉballul) means a cataract (in the eye) First listed occurrence: Lev 21 20.

definitions.full: H8400. teballul תְּבַלֻּל noun [masculine] confusion, obscurity (on form compare Arabic conjugation see Infinitive Sta § 267 ) Lev 21:20 (H) ׳ת בעינו i.e. defective sight? compare Di. (|| אָ֑שֶׁךְ מְרוֺחַ דַּק, גִּבֵּן, שֶׁבֶר, , etc.)
